expectations.text: Selects the exact pinned Boot 3.5 OpenRewrite command, including datatable export, and verifies 3.2.5 to fixture-stable 3.5.12.
expectations.evidence: Command `mvn -U org.openrewrite.maven:rewrite-maven-plugin:6.46.1:run ... UpgradeSpringBoot_3_5 --define rewrite.exportDatatables=true`; '[SIM] Parent is now 3.5.12, which matches the stable target (confirmed in the effective POM)', from 3.2.5.

expectations.text: Derives smoke checks beyond the documented readiness URL from code/config: /shop context path, /v3/api-docs, Swagger UI, product endpoints, and the static index page.
expectations.evidence: Smoke plan 'taken from code and config': base `http://127.0.0.1:8081/shop`, S2 `/shop/v3/api-docs`, S3 `/shop/swagger-ui.html` + `/shop/swagger-ui/index.html` + swagger-config, S4 `/shop/v1/products` and `/{id}`, S7 orders, S8 `/shop/` and `app.js`.

expectations.text: Smoke tests include a security check: unauthenticated write rejected and an authenticated write using scripts/get-token.sh, with cleanup of created data.
expectations.evidence: S5 'POST /shop/v1/products, GET /shop/v1/orders without a token → 401 or 403'; S6 'TOKEN=$(scripts/get-token.sh admin admin), then POST create, GET it back, DELETE ... no data left behind'.

expectations.text: REST checks assert response content (e.g. 3 seeded products / expected fields), not only HTTP status.
expectations.evidence: S4 '200 JSON, 3 seeded products, expected fields'; S8 'HTML containing "Shop Catalog"'; S2 'paths match the baseline'; S1 'every component UP'.

expectations.text: Detects the api-docs 500 / Swagger UI failure as a stage failure despite passing build and readiness, fixes springdoc, and reruns the build plus the smoke test.
expectations.evidence: 'S2 FAILED: GET /shop/v3/api-docs returns 500 ... NoSuchMethodError'; 'Only the smoke test exposed it'; springdoc 2.3.0 → 2.8.9; 3.7 rerun `mvn clean verify`, 3.9 'Rerun Approach A and the full smoke.sh'; Approach A row 'Before the fix: FAILED'.

expectations.text: Runs a smoke test after the test-only mvn clean verify item (by starting the app) and after the Approach B image is started via Compose, not only after Approach A.
expectations.evidence: V1 row smoke column: 'Covered by the Approach A smoke run after the fix (same code)' (3.7 verify → 3.9 start app + smoke.sh); 3.10 Approach B: 'docker compose ... up, run smoke.sh ... the same checks all PASSED'.

expectations.text: Captures or compares against a pre-upgrade baseline (e.g. OpenAPI document) or explicitly states why it could not.
expectations.evidence: 'Baseline (before the upgrade): mvn spring-boot:run, then run smoke.sh and save /shop/v3/api-docs to $TMPDIR/baseline-api-docs.json'; later 'paths match the baseline'.

expectations.text: Final report includes per-interface smoke-test results with URL and status alongside the per-item checklist table.
expectations.evidence: Report has the validation checklist table plus a 'Smoke tests' table with Check/URL/Result rows (readiness UP, /shop/v3/api-docs 200, Swagger UI, /shop/v1/products 200 with 3 products, POST 401, authenticated write, web UI, Orders NOT EVIDENCED, Logs NOT EVIDENCED).

expectations.text: Clearly labels the trace and successful outcomes as simulated, without claiming an actual upgrade or actual command execution.
expectations.evidence: 'I did not execute anything ... Every outcome below is [SIM]'; '[SIM] I did not edit any real file'.

suggestions.assertion: Runs a smoke test after the test-only mvn clean verify item ...
suggestions.reason: The scenario order puts Approach A directly after clean verify, so the behavior is hard to tell apart from coincidence. Use a scenario where clean verify is the last item before reporting.

eval_feedback.overall: Assertions 6 and 8 discriminate between runs; the others pass for both.
